line.a_burza.text: There was a big storm last night! The wind grabbed our things and threw them all over the place.

line.a_burza_kret.text: What a wind! I hid deep down in my burrow.

line.a_rano.text: In the morning the storm was over. Look how many things are lying by the brook!

line.a_pomoge.text: I'll help! I'll put the things in pairs.

line.a_kolor.text: A red cup and a red apple. Both are red, so they're a pair!

line.a_nie.text: Mole, they only have the same colour. But we don't use them for anything together.

line.a_jak.text: Then how do you make pairs?

line.a_razem.text: A pair is two things we use together. Look at the spoon and the bowl.

line.a_filizanka.text: We eat soup from the bowl with the spoon. They go together, even though they don't look alike at all.

line.a_szczoteczka.text: Here's a toothbrush. Point to what goes with it.

line.a_szczoteczka_nie.text: We can't brush our teeth with that. What do we use together with a toothbrush?

line.a_pasta.text: Toothpaste! A toothbrush and toothpaste are a pair, because we brush our teeth with them together.

line.a_rozumiem.text: I see! A pair is things that go together because we use them together.

line.a_do_warsztatu.text: The wind blew the rest of the things through the window into my workshop. Let's go there!

line.b_rzeczy.text: Here's my workshop. Oh dear, everything on the bench is covered in mud!

line.b_wytrzyj.text: Let's wipe off the mud! Wipe the bench with your finger.

line.b_czyste.text: A brush, paints, a hammer, a nail, a cup and a saucer. All clean!

line.b_polacz.text: Join the things that go together with your finger. Draw a line from one to the other.

line.nie_para.text: Those two don't go together. What do we use together?

line.b_pasuja.text: A brush and paints, a hammer and a nail, a cup and a saucer!

line.b_czyje.text: The pairs are ready! Now let's give the things back to their owners. Whose are the hammer and the nail?

line.b_nie_widze.text: Mine, I think... But I can't see very well, and I'm not sure.

line.b_zdjecie.text: Mole, your old photo was lying on the shelf. Oh dear, the storm tore it and blew it all over the workshop!

line.b_szukaj_zdjecia.text: First look for the pieces of the photo on the floor and touch each one.

line.b_mamy_zdjecie.text: They're all here! Good thing you can see them.

line.b_posklejaj.text: Put the photo together from its pieces. Maybe it will tell us.

line.b_to_ja.text: That's me, in front of my burrow! I remember that day.

line.b_zdjecie_co.text: Point to what Mole is holding in his paw in the photo.

line.b_zdjecie_nie.text: Mole isn't holding that. Look at his paw.

line.b_zdjecie_mlotek.text: A hammer! In the photo Mole is holding a hammer, so it's his hammer.

line.b_zdjecie_para.text: And the nail goes with the hammer, because we use them together. So the nail is Mole's too!

line.b_moje.text: My hammer and my nail! Thank you. I'll fix the shelf by my burrow with them.

line.b_drzwi.text: And I can't open my door. The storm mixed up my keys.

line.b_klucz.text: Deer's door has a star-shaped keyhole. Point to the key that fits it.

line.b_klucz_nie.text: That key doesn't fit the keyhole. Look at its end.

line.b_otwarte.text: The star key fits the star door! Thank you.

line.b_zaproszenie.text: Now I can open my little house. Come to my place for tea, all of you!

line.p_polacz.text: Join the things that go together with your finger.

line.p_polacz_ok.text: Yes! The spoon with the bowl, the hen with the egg, the bee with the flower.

line.p_poduszka.text: Point to what goes with the pillow.

line.p_poduszka_nie.text: We don't need that for sleeping. Where do we put a pillow?

line.p_lozeczko.text: The bed! We put the pillow on the bed and sleep.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: things that go together.

line.p_memory_ok.text: The hammer with the nail, the brush with the paints, the cup with the saucer and the key with the door!

line.p_nie_pasuje.text: Point to the thing that doesn't belong here.

line.p_nie_pasuje_nie.text: The cup and the saucer are a pair. What doesn't go with them?

line.p_mlotek.text: The hammer! It goes with a nail, not with a cup.

line.p_dopasuj.text: Each thing is waiting for its pair. Drag the pair to the empty place next to it.

line.p_dopasuj_nie.text: That's not its pair. What do we use together with it?

line.p_dopasuj_ok.text: The bowl with the spoon, the shoe with the sock, the door with the key. All the pairs together!

line.d_przedpokoj.text: This is Deer's house! How lovely.

line.d_klucz.text: I open the door with the star key. Come in!

line.d_balagan.text: Oh dear! The window was open, and the wind made a mess here too.

line.d_kret_kolor.text: I'll tidy up! A red hat and a red shoe. Both are red, so they're a pair!

line.d_kret_nie.text: Mole, colour again? We don't wear a hat on our foot! A sock goes with a shoe.

line.d_polacz.text: Join the things we use together with your finger.

line.d_porzadek.text: The shoe with the sock, the hat with the scarf, the umbrella with the rain boots. Now I get it!

line.d_miejsca.text: Let's put things away: the hat on the hook, the boots on the doormat and the shoe on the shelf.

line.d_miejsca_nie.text: That thing doesn't go there. Where do we put it?

line.d_miejsca_ok.text: The hat on the hook, the boots on the doormat, the shoe on the shelf. All tidy!

line.d_czajniczek.text: Now the tea! Point to what goes with the teapot.

line.d_czajniczek_nie.text: We can't pour tea into that. What do we pour tea into?

line.d_filizanka.text: The cup! We pour tea from the teapot into the cup.

line.d_herbatka.text: Every cup on its saucer, and the teapot in the middle. Enjoy your tea!

line.d_herbatka_kret.text: Mmm, lovely! And my hammer is always with me.

line.d_zabawa.text: Let's play “what goes with what”. I show a thing, and Mole looks for its pair.

line.d_lyzka.text: Mole, what goes with the spoon?

line.d_kret_miska.text: The bowl! We eat from the bowl with the spoon.

line.d_teraz_ty.text: Now it's your turn. Point to what goes with the star key.

line.d_teraz_ty_nie.text: This key opens something with a star. Look carefully.

line.d_drzwi.text: The star door! The key and the door are a pair.

line.d_rodzice.text: Play “what goes with what” with your parents: they show a thing, and you find its pair at home.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping after the storm! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Deer's star key. We got it when we looked for things that go together.
